record.one_liner: An API for accessing peer-reviewed research, citations, and the Consensus Research Agent to build automated R&D and evidence-backed AI tools.
record.blocker: Unclear free tier or self-serve test credential availability beyond paid plans.

auth_methods.quote: Create API key Read the docs How Phylo powers drug discovery with Consensus → Peer-reviewed research, one API call away.

access_ship.quote: What's in the API. The same index, filters and research agent behind Consensus. Included on every paid plan, and Deep includes 5x the usage of Pro.

api_type.quote: GET /v1/search index ~1s 1 0.98 2 0.94 3 0.91 GET /v1/search Search Ranked papers for your own pipeline.

api_breadth.quote: Two ways to build. Search returns ranked papers in one call. Threads hands the whole research task to the Consensus agent.
